featured_reviews.review_text:
Overall, the doctor appears knowledgeable and competent in his field. However, my experience as a parent was somewhat disappointing from a communication and empathy standpoint.

During our consultation regarding our child's eye condition, we were trying to better understand the diagnosis and the findings related to the vision in one eye. As parents, naturally we had several questions and concerns. Unfortunately, it felt as though our questions were being interpreted as a challenge to the doctor's assessment rather than an attempt to understand our child's situation.

What stood out to me was the lack of empathy during the discussion. Parents are often anxious and emotional when it comes to their children's health, and a little patience and reassurance can make a significant difference. As a pediatric specialist, I believe communication and sensitivity are just as important as clinical expertise.

I have no reason to doubt the doctor's medical knowledge, and many others seem to have had positive experiences. However, based on my own interaction, I was left feeling uncomfortable and not fully supported as a parent. For that reason, I remain undecided about whether I would recommend this doctor to others.

featured_reviews.name: Shailesh Varun
featured_reviews.review_text:
Everything else was good, and even the doctor Hitesh was very supportive and polite . I need an urgent appointment due to some issue and he personally came with me to the receptionist to request an earlier appointment.
However, one thing made my experience very disappointing,... I wasted my time and money for nothing...
I visited the clinic for the second time to finalize my father’s cataract surgery with Dr. Hitesh. After completing all the procedures and finalizing the surgery date with the doctor, we were informed that the surgery could not proceed because their cashless department denied my insurance. The staff member said they do not have a good experience with Tata AIG and therefore do not provide cashless service for this particular insurance holder. Instead, they demanded a 100% cash deposit for the surgery..........
I would not have had any issue if this had been clearly communicated during my first visit. During my initial appointment, I specifically asked whether you provide cashless services. The receptionist said yes and asked which insurance company I had. I clearly informed them that it was Tata AIG.....
Today, after completing all the required eye reports and finalizing everything, we were told at the last moment that we must pay the full amount in advance. If I have to pay 100% in cash, then what is the point of opting for a cashless service??????.......
If your clinic does not provide cashless services for Tata AIG insurance holders, then please remove it from your network list and inform patients clearly during the first visit.............
No hard feelings, but this situation caused unnecessary stress and wasted both my time and money.  & I didn’t want to post a negative comment, but I’m leaving this here to help anyone with Tata AIG insurance avoid the same situation.

UPDATE Response:-  Thank you for your response.

I understand that reimbursement is possible. However, my concern is not about whether I will eventually get the claim amount back. The issue is that I was specifically informed during my first visit that cashless service was available. Based on that assurance, I completed all the tests and finalized the surgery date...........
If reimbursement was the only option, I should have been clearly informed earlier. Arranging a 100% advance payment at the last moment is difficult and defeats the purpose of opting for a cashless insurance policy....................
My request is simply that patients should be clearly informed in advance if cashless service is not available for a particular insurance provider, so they can plan accordingly and avoid unnecessary stress, time, and expense.

Planning a visit to our center in Borivali West? Here is what patients ask us most frequently about our eye care services:

🗓️ What should I bring to my consultation?
Please bring any previous eye reports, your current prescription glasses, and a list of any ongoing medications you take.

⏳ How long does a routine check-up take?
A comprehensive vision test and eye exam typically take 30 to 45 minutes. If your consultation requires pupil dilation for a deeper evaluation, please plan for up to 2 hours.

👁️ What happens during a routine eye exam?
We perform a complete vision test alongside refraction to check your glasses prescription. Dr. Ami Shah also conducts an eye pressure check and a detailed slit-lamp examination to evaluate both the anterior and interior health of your eyes.

🏥 What medical and surgical services are available?
With over 10 years of experience, Dr. Ami Shah provides complete care including modern laser vision correction, advanced micro-incision cataract surgery with premium lens options, and comprehensive glaucoma screenings. We also specialize in dry eye treatment and routine pediatric eye evaluations.

Eyecare tips in summer.

During Summers, a mix of heat, dust and dehydration can cause several eye issues. 
Here are some tips which can help prevent eye issues. 

1. Don’t skip sunglasses
Go for sunglasses that block 99–100% of UV rays. Prolonged UV exposure can increase the risk of conditions like cataracts and photokeratitis. 

2.Stay hydrated
Your eyes rely on proper tear production. Dehydration can worsen dryness and irritation, sometimes leading to dry eye syndrome.

3.Limit direct sun exposure
Try to avoid peak sunlight hours (roughly 11 AM–4 PM). Wearing a hat or sunglasses will protect your eyes.

4.Protect against dust and pollution
If you’re outdoors a lot, especially in windy or dusty areas, use protective eyewear. Dust can trigger allergies. 

5.Use lubricating eye drops (if needed)
Artificial tears can help keep your eyes moist, especially if you spend time in air-conditioned rooms.
